limits: Named unique footprint references only; absolute translation in millimetres, integer-nm saved readback with 1 nm tolerance. Angles, side, pad nets, outline and every non-pose board byte remain protected.

A selected locked footprint refuses the entire multi-target request before preflight or engineering write, with ref/UUID details. Modern and legacy bare locked encodings in supported footprint nodes are enforced; no unlock or force bypass.

plan.extensions.preflight follows kicad-cli://schemas/move-preflight/v1. The selected command reference publishes preflight_schema and its result-subtree definition; engineering_feedback.geometry_check is official_native_drc_limited.

The operation-owned state_dir/move-preflights workspace contains preparation, baseline and candidate projects/configurations. Original inputs are not native writable targets; exact requested candidate/protected-byte comparison is required.

Clone supported local KiCad footprint libraries and configuration; register necessary table/path relocation. Initialize only preparation copies, then freeze formal inputs. Unsupported remote/nonlocal library kinds and unresolved dependencies refuse; this is not a general sandbox.

Bind original PCB, project/custom rules and absent sidecars, configuration membership and bytes, selected libraries and table variables, tool version/content, candidate and report artifacts. Recheck before confirmation dispatch and again under the writer lock; drift refuses the original confirmation without silently rechecking/replacing its reports.

Official native reports compare type, severity/exclusion, object UUID/machine net/layer and necessary positions as multisets. New findings or blocking new reported unconnected endpoint pairs make can_apply=false; removed old findings cannot offset new ones. Original ignores and included severities remain exact.

Existing-violation position changes conservatively count as new; unconnected report anchors may be reselected and are not the complete connectivity graph. Machine feedback includes moved footprint/pad world positions/nets and concrete finding/connection changes. Copper never follows moved pads.

Missing dependencies, timeout, abnormal exit, incomplete ownership or missing/corrupt reports are incomplete errors, never a clean preflight. A started native call is not automatically retried. Exit zero alone does not establish a valid or clean report.
The move preflight has official_native provenance; board check and drc_baseline retain their distinct custom checker provenance. No native report is passed off as a custom-checker result.

Before native calls, the separate placement_guard requires supported F.Cu zero-degree footprints, ordinary zero-degree SMD rect/roundrect pads, straight fp_line/fp_rect/fp_poly artwork with a measurable front courtyard, and exactly four straight rectangular board-level Edge.Cuts lines. Unsupported/incomplete geometry, locks, a selected conservative envelope touching/outside the board-edge centerline or touching/intersecting any other candidate footprint envelope refuses the entire batch. Target-target and target-nontarget pairs are checked together. Nontext envelopes use full graphic-stroke guard bands and outward integer-nm pad bounds; they can conservatively reject shapes which do not actually touch. Fields/text stay byte protected but are outside these envelopes. Confirmation independently recomputes and matches the bound baseline/candidate witness and requested translations. This is not arbitrary-outline or exact polygon collision checking; the full connectivity graph, full artwork and manufacturing signoff remain unestablished. No automatic routing repair/refill, unlock, rotation or layer change.

A consumed move token refuses even with the same key. A fresh passing preview token with identical parameters and the original idempotency key may retrieve the original receipt with replayed=true and no second engineering dispatch; schematic-edit replay rules remain separate.

Recovery records an actual re-observation; never repeats a lost write or restores an externally changed board. Old-tool confirmations are refused by the current tool binding; preserve unknown outcomes instead of replaying them.

Keep all raw connection-edge changes. Only a unique one-for-one common-anchor replacement can be nonblocking: unchanged ordinary through-via/straight-track copper junction, same flags and unchanged other endpoint/parent, exact integer-nm contact, positive widths/annulus and sufficient length, on a net disjoint from every moved pad net. A single unique plain via may directly witness two straight tracks at that point. No padstack/unused-layer removal, arc/pad/zone alias, transitive connectivity or whole-net exemption; all other new edges still block.

Before any connection-edge grouping or matching, every baseline/candidate unconnected item.pos must exactly match its own saved-board GetPosition reference for KiCad 10.0.6: straight-track stored start, via center or pad world center. A retained UUID/net pair may have different valid moved-pad world positions; it must not reuse an obsolete position. Incorrect, unsupported or unproved references make the preflight incomplete. Report references are separate from physical junctions. Alias proof still requires a unique match in both directions, unchanged other endpoint/parent, and records old/new report positions plus the independent junction; arbitrary track endpoints/midpoints are not admitted.

A separate custom saved-board proof may explain changed official report trees only when all unchanged supported zero-angle F.Cu SMD pads are strictly disjoint singletons on both boards with no other copper; both reports must be complete unique per-net spanning trees. Raw edges remain visible, new DRC findings still block, and no general connection graph is established.

E_NATIVE_FAILURE.description: The application rejected the operation and nothing lasting remained; read the receipt.

E_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.description: The operation may have run and its result could not be established; query the operation and read back the target before anything else.

E_PARTIAL.description: Some requested stages or items took effect and others did not; read the receipt; never resend the whole request.

E_PROTOCOL.description: The backend replied with something the CLI cannot read; read details.dispatch_state before any further write.

E_UNSUPPORTED.description: A valid request this build, mode or session cannot carry out; choose another capability.

E_VERIFY_FAILED.description: The operation took effect and a required read-back check failed.

E_VERIFY_INCOMPLETE.description: The operation took effect and a required read-back check could not be completed.

circuit_spec.description: Contents of --spec, not the CLI argument object. Schematic placement/grouping is automatic from topology. Explicit positions, rotation and manual groups are unsupported. Pin numbers are preferred; pin names resolve against the installed symbol. No application electrical sign-off is implied. Optional hierarchy declares exactly one root and two distinct direct child files, true sheet pins and hierarchical labels. No nesting, shared child instances or buses; deterministic identities and all output names bind to the same captured request.

canonical_nets.description: Exact predeclared full names for every net ID; child signals use /sheet-name/local-name, never slash-stripped comparison.

file.description: One safe plain output basename, distinct under Windows casefold; reserved names, paths and root/project/netlist collisions refuse.

shared_power_nets.description: Only declared GND or +supply nets may use global power symbols; ordinary signals use real hierarchy ports.

connect.description: At least two REF.PIN strings; connect is the field name, not pins/connections.

footprint.description: Library:Footprint; absent/empty uses symbol default. PCB generation requires an installed footprint for each physical component.

sheet_id.description: Required with hierarchy; one physical part including all units belongs to exactly one declared page.

value.description: Optional display value; absent, empty or null uses the library default.

out.description: Existing output directory; no implicit directory creation.

spec.description: Path to JSON satisfying $defs.circuit_spec. File content validation happens before library resolution and dispatch.

add.description: Add every pin-bearing unit, body style 1, zero rotation using existing automatic room search. Returned placed.at_mm coordinates and wire_mm are millimetres. Explicit position/angle/unit/group fields unsupported. Hidden supply pins retain library semantics. Review all new symbols, fields, labels and wires.

dnp.description: Explicit KiCad symbol flag; default is false.

exclude_from_sim.description: Explicit KiCad symbol flag; default is false.

fields.description: Arbitrary named text metadata retained; takes precedence over value/footprint/default fields. Reference is selected by ref, not metadata. Numeric/null entries are not silently ignored.

footprint.description: Library Footprint by default; empty shorthand falls back to library. fields.Footprint can explicitly clear/override. A resolvable mapping is required before PCB sync.

in_bom.description: Explicit KiCad symbol flag; default is true.

near.description: Existing reference on selected sheet; automatic placement hint, not an exact coordinate. If sheet is omitted, also chooses its sheet.

on_board.description: Explicit KiCad symbol flag; default is true.

additionalProperties.description: Exact existing canonical net first; otherwise REF.PIN for an existing reference (number before pin name); otherwise a new local label text without leading /. A pin target must already have a usable naming carrier; rename an unnamed net first.

pins.description: Pin number or exact pin-name -> target selector; numbers precede names, named groups may select several pins. Unspecified visible pins receive no-connect markers. Conflicting aliases for the same pin refuse.

ref.description: Unused exact reference, or prefix? for lowest free positive number. All reused-sheet placements get distinct references; exact request applies to the selected instance.

sheet.description: Exact sheet instance name path, e.g. / or /CHILD_A/. Default: sheet containing near, otherwise root. A reused file changes all its placements.

symbol.description: LIBRARY:NAME. Embedded symbol copy takes precedence, else project/config library tables. Power symbols cannot be added; use connect to a supply name.

value.description: Library Value by default; existing empty-string shorthand also falls back to the library. fields.Value can explicitly override, including empty text.

connect.description: Connect a free pin, removing its no-connect marker. Existing attached wires/labels/other contacts are refused even when the requested net is already its net. Cross-sheet local-net and bus/ambiguous targets are refused.

net.description: Exact existing canonical net first; otherwise REF.PIN for an existing reference (number before pin name); otherwise a new local label text without leading /. A pin target must already have a usable naming carrier; rename an unnamed net first.

pin.description: String pin number first; otherwise exact pin name, applying to every matching named pin. Number selection uses the first drawn occurrence. No unit/body-style selector is exposed. Previews list matched_pins with physical numbers, units and instance paths. A legacy nameless ~ marker is not a selectable name; use the physical number shown by readback.

disconnect.description: Detach only what exclusively serves the selected pin; retain shared interface geometry. Direct other-pin/sheet-pin/bus contacts and branch junctions at this pin refuse; shared sheet placements also change.

no_connect.description: Place/retain a no-connect marker after detaching. False leaves the pin free and can introduce ERC findings.

pin.description: String pin number first; otherwise exact pin name, applying to every matching named pin. Number selection uses the first drawn occurrence. No unit/body-style selector is exposed. Previews list matched_pins with physical numbers, units and instance paths. A legacy nameless ~ marker is not a selectable name; use the physical number shown by readback.

remove.description: Remove every drawn unit of the selected component and every coupled placement of its reused sheet. Keep shared wires, junctions and hierarchical interfaces. Does not delete a PCB footprint; project sync preserves unmatched PCB objects by default; explicit isolated removal uses its separate selection file.

rename.description: Rename all naming carriers of one net, including coupled placements of a reused sheet. Preserve pin membership and electrical anchors; merge/split, bus and hidden-power naming ambiguity is refused. Plain 1.27mm default-font ASCII orthogonal local labels may turn at the retained anchor to avoid conservative canvas conflicts; no clear orientation is refused. label_layout reports objects/angles/anchors. Other carriers/styles retain explicit visual-only limits; no full-page relayout.

net.description: Exact current canonical net name, including sheet path such as /OUT2. Does not select a component reference.

to.description: New naming-carrier text, not a new full sheet path; existing sheet qualification is retained.

set.description: Set existing component text fields or flags on all units; existing text positions are retained. field_layout previews per-field before/after, units and shared instances with advisory conservative bounds and explicit unmeasured styles; native full-image review remains required. Power symbols require net renaming instead.

fields.description: Named fields; overrides shorthand fields. Reference cannot be changed here. Mandatory fields may be emptied, not removed; null removes an optional field.

changes_file.description: Ordered nonempty changes. Each operation sees prior changes; one rejected shape/domain/invariant prevents writing the entire batch. File accepts UTF-8 with optional BOM. All operations reject unknown fields; top-level wrapper metadata remains allowed. Shapes do not prove library, connectivity or design-intent validity. Structural defects are reported before project/library-dependent errors; fix the reported fields and re-preview for remaining domain diagnostics.

oneOf.description: Other wrapper keys remain accepted caller metadata; they are not interpreted as edit operations and are not written into the schematic.

operation_syntax.add: Add every pin-bearing unit, body style 1, zero rotation using existing automatic room search. Returned placed.at_mm coordinates and wire_mm are millimetres. Explicit position/angle/unit/group fields unsupported. Hidden supply pins retain library semantics. Review all new symbols, fields, labels and wires.
operation_syntax.connect: Connect a free pin, removing its no-connect marker. Existing attached wires/labels/other contacts are refused even when the requested net is already its net. Cross-sheet local-net and bus/ambiguous targets are refused.
operation_syntax.disconnect: Detach only what exclusively serves the selected pin; retain shared interface geometry. Direct other-pin/sheet-pin/bus contacts and branch junctions at this pin refuse; shared sheet placements also change.
operation_syntax.remove: Remove every drawn unit of the selected component and every coupled placement of its reused sheet. Keep shared wires, junctions and hierarchical interfaces. Does not delete a PCB footprint; project sync preserves unmatched PCB objects by default; explicit isolated removal uses its separate selection file.
operation_syntax.rename: Rename all naming carriers of one net, including coupled placements of a reused sheet. Preserve pin membership and electrical anchors; merge/split, bus and hidden-power naming ambiguity is refused. Plain 1.27mm default-font ASCII orthogonal local labels may turn at the retained anchor to avoid conservative canvas conflicts; no clear orientation is refused. label_layout reports objects/angles/anchors. Other carriers/styles retain explicit visual-only limits; no full-page relayout.
operation_syntax.set: Set existing component text fields or flags on all units; existing text positions are retained. field_layout previews per-field before/after, units and shared instances with advisory conservative bounds and explicit unmeasured styles; native full-image review remains required. Power symbols require net renaming instead.

urn:kicad-cli:sch-edit-request:1.qualification: All six existing operations have closed operation shapes, examples and selection/default rules. Runtime domain checks remain necessary; successful edits/custom ERC are not independent intent, native ERC, visual or PCB acceptance. Wrapper metadata semantics are retained.

mask_observations.description: Required in the actual explicit-target report. All encountered supported same-side pad/graphic/track openings and ordinary-through-via effective tenting observations; missing APIs, unsupported shapes or unproved via membership make the report incomplete. Tenting does not assert hole fill or supplier process. Host consumes strict branch fields and rechecks mask rectangles against target envelopes and frozen clearance.

targets_file.description: References, footprint UUIDs and Reference UUIDs must each be unique across the selection; board identities and exact original positions are checked before native preparation. JSON duplicate keys refuse. A no-op target is permitted.

from_mm.description: World millimetres, finite, exactly expressible in integer nanometres and within native signed-32-bit nanometre storage (-2147.483648..2147.483647 mm); booleans are not coordinates.

remove_footprint_file.description: One exact saved identity/pad snapshot; all physical pads, including duplicate pad numbers, are required. Values come from the retained object in an ordinary sync preview. Selection is a bound input file, never ref-only/delete-all. No coordinate or unit conversion is performed. Bind root schematic UUID and bytes from preview.extensions.schematic_identity. Selected footprint must be in the root sheet; hierarchical deletion is unsupported. Example UUIDs/hashes illustrate shape only; replace every identity/hash with the exact current public preview, never use wildcards.
